messages:
maria: Heads-up — new org 'redwood-ai-research' needs cross-cloud capacity. I'm starting quota/limit requests for AWS, GCP, and Azure. Need owners for GPU, network, and billing items. Quick summary below, please ACK and call dibs.

maria: TL;DR: target regions us-west1 / eu-west1 / ap-southeast1. GPUs: +12 total (8 A100s + 4 V100s), want ability to spread across providers. Networking: ~100 static external IPs across clouds, Cloud NAT / NAT Gateway capacity, 50k ephemeral port per region, VPC/subnet quotas. IAM: service accounts + key rotation plan. Billing: new billing account and cost-center tags.

cheng: ping — do we need guaranteed on-demand GPUs or can we use preempt/spot for part of this? Also do we have preferred instance SKUs per region?

maria: cheng — prefer reservable on-demand for training baseline (8 GPUs), remaining 4 can be spot/preemptible for experiments. Region SKUs: AWS p4d in us-west-2 if available, otherwise p3dn/p4 in us-west-1; GCP a2 and v100 flavors in us-west1; Azure NCas_T4_v3 / ND_v4 where supported.

sam: cost note — mixing reserved + spot usually reduces % cost a lot. For the 8 baseline GPUs consider committed usage or savings plan on AWS/GCP committed use discounts. If we have to scale quickly, budget needs pre-approval.

ellie: Azure heads-up — NDv4 quotas are stricter in eu-west regions. We'll need quota requests early. Also Azure static public IP SKU Standard is required for scale; each IP is billed.

devon: for IAM: we should create a cross-cloud infra-service account with least privilege for provisioning scripts. Also enable billing export to the org bucket immediately so cost teams can start ingesting. Tagging convention: `env:research`, `team:ai-research`, `cost_center:RR-42`.

ops-bot: Automated ticket created: INFRA-5421. Includes placeholder fields for provider, region, quota type, requested delta. Link: https://internal.redwood/infra/tickets/INFRA-5421

cheng: I'll own GCP quota requests. Prep checklist for GCP: 1) enable Compute API & Service Usage 2) open support > Quotas 3) request GPUs per region (A100/V100) 4) request increase for `IN_USE_ADDRESSES` and `CPUS` if using n1/accelerator VMs 5) request Cloud NAT scaling (if using Cloud NAT)

cheng: sample GCP support body (use this when creating ticket):
```
Project: redwood-ai-research-prod
Requested increases:
- Compute Engine GPUs (region: us-west1): +6 A100
- Compute Engine GPUs (region: eu-west1): +4 A100
- IN_USE_ADDRESSES (global): +40
- CPUS (region: us-west1): +200
- Cloud NAT maximum connections: +100000
Justification: New research org for model development and inference scale testing. Workload includes low-latency inference and training. Budget owner: @sam. Contact: maria@redwood.com
```

maria: thx cheng — that block looks good. Add SLA needs in the form: target provisioning in 7 business days.

sam: AWS checklist: request Service Quotas increases for EC2 G4/G5/P4 families + Elastic IP increase + VPCs per account + ENI limits. CLI example to request quota increase: 
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 100
```
Also ask for accelerated networking feature enabled on instance SKUs.

ellie: Networking things to confirm across clouds:
- Shared VPC vs per-project VPC (recommend shared VPC for centralized egress)
- Firewall baseline (allow internal control plane, deny default inbound)
- NAT capacity (Cloud NAT/egress gateways)
- External IP allocation plan (avoid hitting account-level limits)

devon: tagging + naming checklist (copy these into quota tickets):
- project_id: redwood-ai-research-prod
- billing_account: B-0123456
- labels/tags: `env=research`, `team=ai-research`, `owner=maria`, `cost_center=RR-42`
- folder/org path: /organizations/7890/folders/ai-research

maria: network perf question — for inference nodes we'll want consistent egress. If running in multiple zones within region, enable internal load balancing and sticky sessions at LB. Also ensure subnet secondary ranges for pods (k8s) if we plan hybrid k8s clusters.

cheng: ops checklist for quota submission order (GCP): 1) billing account linked 2) enable APIs 3) open support ticket with body above 4) attach cost approval 5) include service account that will create instances

sam: decision needed — do we request static reserved IPs now or request soft increases and allocate later? Static reservations are billed; recommend soft increases first (IN_USE_ADDRESSES) and reserve only critical ones.

ellie: FYI Azure commands for quota request: portal -> Help + support -> New support request -> Quota -> select subscription -> pick region & SKU. No CLI parity for some ND SKUs; plan longer lead time.

maria: owners: GCP -> cheng, AWS -> sam, Azure -> ellie, IAM & tagging -> devon. I'll coordinate follow-ups and approve cost requests. Please update INFRA-5421 with your ticket IDs as you create them.

cheng: ACK — starting GCP ticket now. ETA to submit: 2 hours.

sam: ACK — I'll open AWS quota ticket and include savings plan estimate. ETA: end of day.

ellie: ACK — Azure request scheduled this afternoon; may need PM from customer success for quota justification in some regions.

devon: I'll create the billing export bucket and put the tag policy in org policy. Ping me if you need access.

maria: Great. If anyone runs into provider support pushback, escalate to me and tag @maria. Let's aim to close initial provisioning requests within 5 business days. :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

cheng: :ok_hand:

ops-bot: INFRA-5421 updated: GCP ticket GCP-2023-889 created by cheng.
